description.narrative: Design phase to determine whether there exist preconditions for a full scale project through Authority Cooperation for contributing to improved systems for Labour Market Information and Intelligence.
Designfas avseende ett fullskaligt projekt med syfte att genom myndighetssamarbete bidra till förbättrade system för arbetsmarknadsinformation för analys och prognoser.

The overall objective for the Design support is to allow for the Swedish Public Emplyment Service (SPES) to explore the pre-conditions for a bilateral project aiming to enhance the labour market information systems and intelligence in Kenya, for improved identification of job opportunites and employment services to jobseekers - linked to improved and more relevant skills development.
The specific objective is to elaborate a complete project proposal for a contribution aiming to enhance labour market information/intelligence in Kenya, for improved identification of job opportunities and employment services to job seekers, and linked to improved and more relevant skills development, through Authority Cooperation between SPES and the Ministry for Labour and Social Protection in Kenya, and in collaboration with other relevant stakeholders. The project proposal will be submitted to Sida/Embassy of Sweden in Nairobi as a deliverable of the design phase.

The contribution was a support to a limited, 4 months' long, design phase for a possible intervention on Agency-to-Agency Cooperation for an Inclusive Labour Market in Kenya. The main purpose and expected outcome of the support was the design of a possible intervention presented in a Project Proposal.
The Project Proposal "Enhanced Labour Market Information in Kenya" was delivered on time by 13 December 2024, and suggests a 3 year collaboration between, mainly, Arbetsförmedlingen and Kenya's Ministry of Labour and Social Protection, in collaboration with other relavant Stakeholders, such as other concerned Ministries, Government Agencies, County Governments, NGOs, and UN Agencies.
The proposal is well written and corresponds fully to the assignment. It is of good quality and includes an analytical approach that provides a good foundation for the proposed intervention. The proposal itself is relevant, given both the current situation in Kenya and the country's challenges with regards to employment and an inclusive labor market, as well as Sweden's reform agenda for development cooperation - not least the thematic priorities on Poverty reduction through job creation, trade and education, and Synergies between the Development Cooperation and Migration Policies, as well as the strive for an enhanced Team Sweden approach also in the larger sense meaning engaging and making the best use of the entire Swedish resource base. The target groups for the proposed project are youth, women, people with disabilities and migrants and refugees.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
